name: Water Bowls
description: Waterbowl in the shape of a lifering, perfect for medium to smaller crabs. Comes in four colours, made with safe non-toxic paint. Smooth surface for easy cleaning, and the bowl has a heavy design to prevent the Krabz from tipping it over.

reviews.comment: Great for childrens setups, but look strange if you want a more natural setup.
Cute design, strong and the kids love watching the crabs bathe in them!
They are too small for jumbo crabs and the paint chips off easily. They are also childish in design, and ruin natural setups.

name: Shells
description: Aussie Krabz prefer the oval and D shapped openings. Some Aussie Krabz like cirle ones, but this is rare. We have a wide range of shell choices, and we recomend natural shells.

reviews.comment: The shells were all so small. I think it would be better if we could choose the sizes, but appart from that, they were pretty good.
Fast delivery, and varied shells. I have happy crabs, thanks guys!

if i could, i would give 0 stars! Seriously, how hard is it to allow customers to choose the colours and types of shells? and for over five bucks too, get out of here! I will be returning to the 2 dollar craft shop for my shells, which come in mixed bags, of 10 for 5 bucks instead! thanks for nothing

name: Salt Pools
description: These salt pools are perfect size for small medium and large crabs, featuring steps to make climbing out easier and safer. Coming in 4 different colours, with a solid, heavy design - no need to worry about the Krabz tipping all the water out!

reviews.comment: Don't buy this! The paint peels off after a few months, and the crabs might eat the paint. Dissapointed.
Finaly I have a water bowl that my crabs can't tip over! Love the colours too, so cute!

name: Munchiez
description: A varied mix of dried foods including mealworms, seeds, dried shimp, dried fruits and dried flowers. Perfect for a varied diet for your Krabz to be healthy and srtong, please feed along with plenty of fresh fruits and veggies!
